release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.19

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

Labels is part of this program. The header Labelmaker button opens it. The Labels chip is no longer in the tool row.

Print, in LockStepPDF and in Labels, opens the PDF in the computer's default viewer. Print from there at actual size, with fit-to-page turned off. The printer list is gone.

A one-page file can be edited from its file row. Color, Rotate, Resize, Crop, Bleed, and Blank no longer ask you to highlight a page when the file has only one page. After a color change, that file keeps its color label, and the monitor thumbnails stay drawn instead of turning white.

The tool chips read Crop Marks, Rearrange, and Multi-up. They are the same Cutter, Arrange, and Grid tools. Saved recipes and hot folders still use the old step names.
